tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Authority to carry out this subchapter $40,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029, to remain available until expended.

tree.heading: Administrative expenses
tree.text: Not more than 5 percent of the amount appropriated under subsection (a) for a fiscal year shall be used for administrative expenses of the Authority.

tree.heading: Minimum State share of grants
tree.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this subchapter, for any fiscal year, the aggregate amount of grants received by a State and all persons or entities in the State under this subchapter shall be not less than ⅓ of the product obtained by multiplying—

children.text: the aggregate amount of grants under this subchapter for the fiscal year; and
the population of the State (as determined by the Secretary of Commerce based on the most recent decennial census for which data are available); bears to
the population of the region (as so determined).

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Pub. L. 110–234 and Pub. L. 110–246 made identical amendments to this section. The amendments by Pub. L. 110–234 were repealed by section 4(a) of Pub. L. 110–246.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 383N of Pub. L. 87–128, title III, was renumbered section 383O and was classified to section 2009bb–13 of this title prior to repeal by Pub. L. 118–272.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2025—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 118–272 substituted “$40,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029” for “$30,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2008 through 2018”. 2014—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 113–79 substituted “2018” for “2012”. 2008—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 110–246, § 6026(j), substituted “2008 through 2012” for “2002 through 2007”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2008 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment of this section and repeal of Pub. L. 110–234 by Pub. L. 110–246 effective May 22, 2008, the date of enactment of Pub. L. 110–234, see section 4 of Pub. L. 110–246, set out as an Effective Date note under section 8701 of this title.
